items.title: Edge AI Voice Controller
items.summary: On-device voice control on an ESP32-S3: 16 kHz I2S capture with DMA ping-pong buffers, prioritized FreeRTOS tasks, integer RMS voice-activity detection, and an INT8 keyword CNN.
items.impact: Local WiFi/UDP lighting and GPIO actuation, a UART diagnostics CLI, microsecond profiling, and DMA/stack telemetry — no cloud in the loop.

items.title: Toxic Chat Classifier
items.summary: LSTM + TF-IDF Linear SVM hybrid that classifies toxic gaming chat on 14k messages, with a leakage-safe training protocol and a Tesseract OCR collector for in-game text.
items.impact: Three-seed late fusion reached 94.5% held-out accuracy and 0.67 toxic-class F1, beating a Linear SVM baseline.

items.title: RISC-V Sonar Plotter
items.summary: Bare-metal sonar in C on a Nios V (RISC-V) processor: concurrent stepper-motor control and hardware timers through memory-mapped I/O, without an RTOS.
items.impact: A custom state machine mixing polling and interrupts captured time-of-flight past single-edge GPIO limits and drove a synchronized 60 Hz VGA radar display.

items.title: Rat-AI-touille
items.summary: Wearable cooking assistant on an ESP32-CAM: live video plus a hardware push-to-talk button sending low-latency UDP triggers to a local Python server.
items.impact: Threaded backend syncs speech-to-text with video frames for Gemini, then a sliding-window state machine answers with local text-to-speech.

items.title: FPGA Handwritten Number Predictor
items.summary: FPGA-accelerated MNIST classifier on the Altera DE1-SoC, written in Verilog and SystemVerilog.
items.impact: Quantized weights to 32-bit fixed-point, mapped on-chip inference onto dual-port BRAM, and verified timing with ModelSim waveforms.

items.title: Shelflife
items.summary: React and FastAPI media tracker with TMDb and Open Library search, server-side caching, and per-user isolation through Postgres row-level security.
items.impact: Hybrid recommender fuses pgvector cosine similarity with genre and contributor heuristics via Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
